| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Ridges** `ridges` | Dark ridges | Dark ridges, Bright ridges | Whether the lines to find are darker or brighter than their surroundings. Vessels in retinal photos are dark. |
| **Smallest scale** `sigmaMin` | 1 | 0.5 to 20 px | The smallest Gaussian sigma. A line of width w responds most near sigma = w / 2 or a little less. |
| **Largest scale** `sigmaMax` | 9 | 0.5 to 20 px | The largest Gaussian sigma. If it is below the smallest scale, only the smallest is used. |
| **Scale step** `sigmaStep` | 2 | 0.5 to 10 px | The step between the scales. The defaults give 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9, the scikit-image defaults. |
| **Beta** `beta` | 0.5 | 0.1 to 2 | How strongly round blobs are suppressed, through R_B = |lambda_1| / lambda_2. The paper uses 0.5. |
| **Gamma** `gamma` | 15 | 1 to 200 | The structure scale, in pixel levels per pixel squared. Responses with S well below gamma are suppressed. scikit-image uses 15. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
